description: Block level energy consumption - projection - business-as-usual scenario is a series of datasets listed in City of Melbourne Open Data Portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by data.melbourne.vic.gov.au. This dataset should be read alongside other energy consumption datasets on the City of Melbourne open data platform as well as the following report: The dataset outlines modelled energy consumption across the City of Melbourne municipality. Coverage: City of Melbourne. The portal lists 3 near-identical datasets in this series (one per month, area, counter or year), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under Environment. Its keywords are building managment, buildings, cityreactivation, climate, electricity, energy. The portal shows 662 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-melbourne-vic-gov-au-portal.
